name: VisOnlyQA
intro: VisOnlyQA 是用于隔离评估LVLM基础几何视觉感知能力的多项选择基准，12项任务覆盖几何图形、化学结构、图表和3D形状。问题刻意避免复杂推理和领域知识。
scale: 1,600道评测题（900真实+700合成）；另有70,000条合成训练样本
intro_en: VisOnlyQA is a multiple-choice benchmark designed to isolate basic geometric visual perception in LVLMs. Its 12 tasks cover geometric shapes, chemical structures, charts, and 3D shapes while deliberately avoiding complex reasoning and domain knowledge.
scale_en: 1,600 evaluation questions (900 real + 700 synthetic); plus 70,000 synthetic training instances
metric_en: Accuracy reported separately for Eval-Real and Eval-Synthetic

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2412.00947v3, Sections 3.1-3.3 (pp.4-5), Section 4 (p.6), and Appendix C (p.23); official repository: https://github.com/psunlpgroup/VisOnlyQA. Pin v3 counts (1,600 evaluation items), not the older 1,200-item description.. VisOnlyQA keeps separate real and synthetic factories. Humans author new questions over figures from MathVista, MMMU, ChartQA, and CharXiv, and a second annotator verifies every pair; annotators balance option labels, options are shuffled, and true/false questions receive negative counterparts. A manual audit of 100 randomly selected Eval-Real items found all valid. Independently, SyntheticGeometry, CLEVR, and SuperCLEVR metadata are processed by exact Python programs and templates without an LLM to produce Eval-Synthetic and Train. Version 3 releases 900 real and 700 synthetic evaluation items plus 70k synthetic training items.
